about.intro: Shandong Jingyang Greenhouse Technology Co., Ltd. is located in Shenxian County, Liaocheng City, Shandong Province. We integrate greenhouse R&D, design, construction, accessories and services. We specialize in all types of greenhouse engineering, and produce and sell greenhouse frames, parts and automated equipment.
